children: DECISION FROM THE SUPREME ADMINISTRATIVE COURT REGARDING SALE-LEASEBACK TRANSACTION FOR PRODUCTION FACILITIES IN SWEDEN
SUPREME ADMINISTRATIVE COURT  PROCESSED APPEAL AND DECIDED NOT TO GRANT LEAVE TO APPEAL
SUPREME ADMINISTRATIVE COURT CONCLUDED THAT REQUIREMENTS FOR GRANTING LEAVE TO APPEAL WERE NOT MET AND DID NOT EXAMINE MERITS OF CASE
JUDGMENT OF ADMINISTRATIVE COURT OF APPEAL REMAINS IN FORCE, AND BJUV MUNICIPALITY'S APPROVAL OF TRANSACTION HAS NOT BEEN REVOKED.
